segments.text: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire in California.
segments.translation: 消防队员们终于扑灭了加利福尼亚的一场森林大火。

segments.text: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
segments.translation: 从那时起，他们一直在设法查明大火是怎样引起的。

segments.text: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
segments.translation: 森林火灾常常是由碎玻璃或人们随手扔掉的香烟头引起的。

segments.text: Yesterday the firemen examined the ground carefully,
segments.translation: 昨天消防队员们仔细检查了地面，

segments.text: but were not able to find any broken glass.
segments.translation: 但没有发现任何碎玻璃。

segments.text: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
segments.translation: 他们还十分确信不是由香烟头引起的。

segments.text: This morning, however, a firemen accidentally discovered the cause.
segments.translation: 然而今天上午，一个消防队员偶然发现了这场火灾的起因。

segments.text: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.
segments.translation: 他发现了一条缠绕在16,000伏高压线电缆上的蛇的残骸。

segments.text: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
segments.translation: 就这样他解开了这个谜。

segments.text: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
segments.translation: 解释很简单，但很不寻常。

segments.text: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
segments.translation: 一只鸟从地上叼起那条蛇，然后把它扔到了电线上。

segments.text: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
segments.translation: 那条蛇随即缠绕在电线上。

segments.text: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
segments.translation: 当蛇这样做时，就把火花送到了地面上，立即引起了一场大火。
